sources.ref: NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat (textbook pp.18-32), as read in the official NCERT CIET audiobook of the textbook

notes: Tracing for the numerals whose stroke order the textbook describes on pp.25-27 (1, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 9); the steps for 2, 5 and 8 are shown only as pictures, which the audiobook does not describe, so they wait for the printed book. Guides are Rive requests for anim-maker; a person builds them in the Rive editor. Hindi written for this file in simple class 1 Hindi with तुम. The Hindi-medium book (Anandmay Ganit) could not be retrieved, so a reviewer should check the wording and the chapter title.

try_again.hi: चलो, साथ में फिर से देखें।

prompt.en: Trace the number one with your finger.

hint.en: Start with a small slanting line, go straight down, then draw a line along the bottom.
hint.hi: पहले छोटी तिरछी रेखा, फिर सीधे नीचे, फिर नीचे एक लेटी रेखा।

prompt.en: Trace the number three with your finger.

hint.en: Make two little curves, one on top of the other, both open to the left.
hint.hi: दो छोटे घुमाव बनाओ, एक के ऊपर एक, दोनों बाईं ओर खुले।

prompt.en: Trace the number four with your finger.

hint.en: Go straight down, then across, then draw a line down through it.
hint.hi: सीधे नीचे, फिर आड़ी रेखा, फिर उसे काटती हुई नीचे की रेखा।

prompt.en: Trace the number six with your finger.

hint.en: Draw a big curve like the letter C, then join its end round into a circle.
hint.hi: अंग्रेज़ी के C जैसा बड़ा घुमाव बनाओ, फिर उसके सिरे को घुमाकर गोला बना दो।

prompt.en: Trace the number seven with your finger.

hint.en: Draw a line across the top, then a slanting line down from its right end.
hint.hi: ऊपर आड़ी रेखा, फिर उसके दाएँ सिरे से नीचे तिरछी रेखा।

prompt.en: Trace the number nine with your finger.

hint.en: Draw a circle, then a straight line down on its right side.
hint.hi: एक गोला बनाओ, फिर उसके दाईं ओर नीचे सीधी रेखा।
